statement: Micron plans to add up to 60,000 HBM wafers per month of capacity by end of 2026, taking it to roughly 100,000 wafers per month from 40,000-50,000 last year.
why: HBM wafer capacity is the binding physical constraint on how many accelerator packages can ship, so a roughly doubled third-source capacity loosens the tightest link in the chain.

impact.mechanism: More HBM wafer starts raise the bit supply available for accelerator packaging, easing the memory bottleneck that caps merchant GPU and ASIC output.

evidence.excerpt: Micron plans to add up to 60,000 wafers per month in HBM production capacity (based on wafer input) by the end of this year.

confidence.basis: Single secondary trade outlet citing an unnamed industry source; no company filing or confirmation.

dispersion: Capacity figures given as ranges (40,000-50,000 last year; up to 60,000 added; approximately 100,000 total).
